gap: Two tabs: a When picker left open in one tab keeps its own copy of the repeat rule and writes all of it back on its next click. This wipes a rule change typed in the other tab. SEED (clock frozen Tue 2026-03-10 09:00 America/New_York): things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Take out bins',when:'2026-03-12',project:'p_house',repeat:{mode:'schedule',every:1,unit:'week',weekdays:[1,4]}}]. Two tabs in one context, both on #/project/p_house. STEPS: (1) Tab A: double-click the row, click the card's repeat chip (li.editing .chip-repeat). The When picker opens at Repeats: Weekly Mon+Thu, Ends Never. Leave it open. (2) Tab B: same to-do, same chip, Ends > 'After a Number of Times', type 12 in the count field, Enter, Escape, Escape. Storage now has repeat.ends={after:12}. (3) Tab A (its storage event arrived long ago): the picker still shows 'Ends: Never'. Click the Fri weekday toggle, then Escape twice. EXPECTED: tab A changed only the weekdays, so the rule becomes weekdays [1,4,5] with ends {after:12}. CONTRACT, 'Several tabs share one storage': 'a tab ... never writes its stale copy over the other tab's work', and the card writes back 'only ... what was typed in that card'. A break also counts 'something the user typed lost'. ACTUAL (2/2 clean runs): storage repeat={mode:'schedule',every:1,unit:'week',weekdays:[1,4,5]}. The 12 typed in tab B is gone, and after a reload tab B's picker reads 'Ends: Never', so the series now never ends. No page errors. CONTROL: the same steps, but tab A closes and reopens its picker before clicking. The picker then reads 'After' and ends:{after:12} is kept, so the stale copy is the cause. CAUSE: repeat.js controller() reads the rule once into a local variable. Every save() does updateTodo(id,{repeat:{...rule,...}}) from that copy, and nothing refreshes it on a storage event. The same stale copy also revives a series that tab B stopped with Stop Repeating, starting a new series. Repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-pr-Desktop-dev-Todo/7de92c54-84d7-47b2-acf0-63c627b2ff05/scratchpad/recur-r3-c3/repro-twotab-stale-picker-wipes-ends.mjs. ALSO TRIED, no break: 8 seeded random two-tab UI walks of 90 steps each (tick, untick, Cmd+K, card title/notes/checkbox with Escape, delete, Clear completed, Complete All via the toolbar, move, stop repeating, reload, next day), checking open-repeating per series, duplicate occurrence numbers and ends.after. Also heading delete then untick, and Clear completed then Logbook. The project-menu Complete All used twice completes the next occurrence too, and a toggle-all uncheck turns old occurrences into one-offs; both are by contract.
why: A When picker left open in one tab writes its stale repeat rule over the other tab's edit: the Ends count typed there is silently lost
